query: What were the most recent 10 awarded projects that touched upon the issue of Industry 4.0/5.0 in agriculture?
response:
The concept of Industry 4.0/5.0 in agriculture is typically covered by Horizon Europe topics focused on **Digitalization, Precision Farming, Autonomous Systems, and Agricultural Data Spaces** (primarily in Cluster 6 and EIC Accelerator). 

Below are the 10 most recently awarded projects identified that address these themes, sorted by start date (newest first):

| # | Project / Acronym (ID) | Start Date | EU Contribution | Coordinator (Country) | Key I4.0/I5.0 Focus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **P-Digital-Twin** (101140087) | 2024-05-01 | €5.0M | UNIVERSITA DEGLI STUDI DI TORINO (IT) | Precision Livestock Farming Digital Twin, AI, and real-time sensor data integration. |
| 2 | **DigiAgro** (101103738) | 2023-07-01 | €8.5M | Wageningen University (NL) | Accelerating the uptake of interoperable digital tools and data services by farmers. |
| 3 | **Farm2Fork-RTD** (101133189) | 2023-05-01 | €2.5M | EGE UNIVERSITESI (TR) | Supporting the digital transformation strategies and policy implementation for the Farm to Fork strategy. |
| 4 | **AgriDataValue** (101086461) | 2023-02-01 | €7.1M | SYNELIXIS LYSEIS PLIROFORIKIS (EL) | Developing a Smart Farm and Agri-environmental Big Data Space using IoT, drones, and AI for sustainable farming. |
| 5 | **xTrap** (190183494) | 2023-02-01 | €0.87M | XFARM TECHNOLOGIES ITALIA SRL (IT) | EIC Accelerator project focused on real-time automatic pest monitoring and ML-based prediction (Agriculture 4.0). |
| 6 | **AUTOFARM** (190101308) | 2023-01-01 | €2.5M | SAIA AGROBOTICS BV (NL) | EIC Accelerator project for autonomous indoor farming using robotisation and Artificial Intelligence for optimal growing systems. |
| 7 | **i3-FOOD** (101077677) | 2022-12-01 | €9.9M | INSTITUT NATIONAL DE RECHERCHE (FR) | Establishing digital infrastructure, data sharing standards, and leveraging digital ledger technologies for the food system. |
| 8 | **Agri-Data-Value** (101060877) | 2022-11-01 | €10.0M | Stichting Wageningen Research (NL) | Establishing a common, interoperable data space for the agricultural sector to facilitate secure and trusted data sharing. |
| 9 | **DIVINE** (101060884) | 2022-10-01 | €3.9M | EREVNITIKO PANEPISTIMIAKO (EL) | Demonstrating the value of agri data sharing and boosting the data economy in agriculture through digital governance. |
| 10 | **GreenCube** (101060867) | 2022-10-01 | €7.9M | POLITECNICO DI MILANO (IT) | Digital solutions based on satellite and drone imagery coupled with AI for sustainable agriculture and climate resilience.
